name: Redirection
storage_notes: All settings live in the single option redirection_options (array, merged with defaults at read time). Redirects, groups, redirect logs and 404 logs live in custom tables {prefix}redirection_items, {prefix}redirection_groups, {prefix}redirection_logs and {prefix}redirection_404. The DB schema version is stored inside redirection_options['database'] (target REDIRECTION_DB_VERSION 4.2) and must be >= the plugin constant before items/logs are safe to use. Module settings are nested under redirection_options['modules'].

settings.summary: Single settings array; write through red_set_options()/Red_Options::save() which sanitizes, merges defaults and clears the in-memory cache. Read through red_get_options()/Red_Options::get().

auto_target.summary: Auto-generate target URL for new redirects.

expire_redirect.summary: Days to retain redirect logs; -1 disables expiry, max 60.

expire_404.summary: Days to retain 404 logs; -1 disables expiry, max 60.

monitor_post.summary: Group ID that receives redirects when post permalinks change; 0 disables.

monitor_types.summary: Post types monitored for URL changes.

associated_redirect.summary: Fallback target used by post monitoring.

headers.summary: Custom HTTP headers injected by the module.

rest_api.summary: REST route style constant; 0 JSON, 1 JSON index, 3 relative.

settings.summary: Installed DB schema version. Internal: do not write manually; upgrade routines set it after creating/altering tables.
Per-module settings (module 1 = WordPress redirects, module 2 = 404/logging). Internal nested structure updated by Red_Module::update().

actions.name: find_redirect_for_url
actions.summary: Find the redirect matching a URL, including regex/flag matching.

actions.name: create_redirect
actions.summary: Create a redirect after sanitization; requires an existing group. action_data for action_type=url is an array with a url key, e.g. ['url'=>'https://target/'].

actions.name: update_redirect
actions.summary: Update redirect fields; same sanitizer and cache flush as create.

actions.name: delete_redirect
actions.summary: Delete one redirect and flush its module cache.

actions.name: set_redirect_enabled
actions.summary: Enable or disable one redirect without changing its target.

actions.name: bulk_delete_redirects
actions.summary: Delete redirects by filter parameters (or global filters).

actions.name: create_group
actions.summary: Create a redirect group inside a valid module.

actions.name: update_group
actions.summary: Rename a group or move it to another module.

actions.name: delete_group
actions.summary: Delete a group and every redirect inside it.

actions.name: lookup_404s
actions.summary: Read/filter 404 log rows, including exact URL lookup.

params.filterBy: array (url, url-exact, ip, referrer, agent, domain, method, http)

actions.name: delete_404_logs
actions.summary: Delete 404 rows matching filters, or all rows when no filter is given.

actions.name: flush_redirect_cache
actions.summary: Flush the module/redirect cache for a group after direct DB changes.

actions.name: create_group
actions.summary: Create a redirect group in a module.

actions.name: delete_group
actions.summary: Delete a group and all redirects in it.

actions.name: lookup_logs
actions.summary: Read redirect hit logs with filters.

rest_routes.permission: CAP_OPTION_MANAGE / CAP_SITE_MANAGE; fields filtered by capability.

objects.summary: A row in {prefix}redirection_items: source URL, match/action type+code, group, status, position, hit counters.
objects.crud_notes: List: Red_Item::get_all(); read: Red_Item::get_by_id($id); find by URL: get_for_url(); create: Red_Item::create([...]) (sanitizer validates group/match/action); update: $item->update([...]); enable/disable: $item->enable()/disable(); delete: $item->delete(). All object methods flush module cache.

objects.summary: A row in {prefix}redirection_groups: name, module_id, enabled status, position, tracking flag.
objects.crud_notes: List: Red_Group::get_all(); read: Red_Group::get($id); create: Red_Group::create($name,$module_id,$enabled); update: $group->update(['name'=>..,'moduleId'=>..]); delete: $group->delete() also deletes its redirects.

objects.summary: Rows in {prefix}redirection_404: created, url, domain, agent, referrer, http_code, method, request_data, ip.
objects.crud_notes: Read-only for PressAgent: Red_404_Log::get_filtered([...]); exact URL filter is filterBy['url-exact']; delete single: Red_404_Log::delete($id); delete filtered/all: delete_all($params). Never insert rows directly.

objects.summary: Rows in {prefix}redirection_logs: created, url, sent_to, referrer, http_code, redirect_by, redirection_id, ip.
objects.crud_notes: Read via Red_Redirect_Log::get_filtered([...]); delete single via inherited Red_Log::delete($id), filtered delete via delete_all($params).

detection.active_check: defined('REDIRECTION_VERSION') and class_exists('Red_Item'); REDIRECTION_FILE must be defined for a normal load.

pro_notes: No Pro-only items: the readme explicitly states there is no premium version and all features are free (readme.txt:111). Do not look for a separate Pro add-on.
gotchas: Check DB schema before reading/writing: Redirection\Database\Status::needs_updating() compares redirection_options['database'] with REDIRECTION_DB_VERSION 4.2 (includes/database/class-status.php:137,156; redirection.php:16).
Use Red_Item::create()/update() rather than SQL: the sanitizer validates group, match_type, action_type and codes, and serializes action_data (models/redirect/redirect-sanitizer.php:69,232,256).
Red_Item::create() fails if group_id does not exist; fetch a valid group with Red_Group::get_all() first (models/redirect/redirect-sanitizer.php:256).
For action_type=url supply action_data as ['url'=>'https://target/']; Url_Match::save() extracts the url key (matches/url.php:31).
Redirect mutations flush module cache through Red_Module::flush(); direct SQL bypasses this and serves stale redirects (models/module.php:96).
DELETE of a group cascades to all its redirects (models/group.php:292); require explicit confirmation before calling.
REST permissions default to manage_options via Redirection_Capabilities::CAP_DEFAULT; finer-grained caps exist (redirection-capabilities.php:44,80).
404 and redirect logs are pruned according to expire_404/expire_redirect (default 7 days) by scheduled cleanup; missing rows may be retention, not deletion.
